title: Michelle's Blonde Chicken Chili
description: Michelle's blonde chicken chili recipe features great Northern beans, cubed chicken, and green chile peppers, seasoned with garlic, cumin, and oregano.
ingredients: 3 pounds skinless, boneless chicken breast meat - cubed
2 (4 ounce) cans chopped green chile peppers
5 (14.5 ounce) cans great Northern beans, undrained

steps.text: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add chicken; cook, stirring occasionally, until pieces evenly browned. Add onion; cook and stir until translucent. Drain mixture. Set aside.

Combine chicken broth and green chile peppers in a large saucepan over medium heat; bring to a boil. Stir in 3 cans great Northern beans, garlic powder, cumin, oregano, cilantro, and red pepper flakes; stir in chicken-onion mixture until incorporated. Reduce heat.
Simmer chili for at least 30 minutes, adding remaining 2 cans great Northern beans for a thicker consistency.
